programme.title: Bawarchi
programme.desc: Shivnath (Harindranath Chattopadhyay) is the head of the Sharma family, who are so thoroughly argumentative that they have succeeded in scaring away every single cook they've ever employed. So when plucky young chef Raghu (Rajesh Khanna) shows up, nobody expects him to last long. To their surprise, however, he proves remarkably adept at satisfying everyone's independent needs. No sooner do they think him their savior than all the jewelry suddenly disappears.

programme.title: Diwana
programme.desc: Pyarelal, a lovable orphan, is taken in by a Muslim lady. When he gets arrested for murder, no one believes it, but to everyone's shock he admits that he is guilty.

programme.title: Khubsoorat
programme.desc: The lady of a household runs the place with utmost strictness but hilarity and chaos ensues when her daughter-in-law's younger sister pays a visit and tries to change the rules in the house.

programme.title: The Burning Train
programme.desc: An engineer's dream of making the perfect train for Indian Railways is given hope when the company commissions his prototype. After years dedicating himself to his dream, his family has suffered, but now he hopes to make it all up to them with the train's triumphant inaugural journey. However, an embittered fellow employee has other ideas.

programme.desc: JB, a borderline psychopath, is attracted to Lalita, a beautiful, young woman. He forces her to marry him but she runs away on her wedding day by feigning unconsciousness.
